<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**A [[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] man dies while tampering with the [[Israel–Gaza border]]'s automated defences, which detonate. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-blast/palestinian-killed-in-border-fence-explosion-israeli-military-idUSKBN1JE126 (Reuters)]
*Eight [[Kenya]]n security forces officers are killed after their vehicle hits a bomb in the country's east. Local authorities ascribe the killings to [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]]. [https://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/Kenya-8-Security-Force-Members-Killed-in-Bomb-Blast-20180618-0005.html (teleSUR)]
*[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] kidnaps and executes six people in [[Mosul]], [[Iraq]]. [https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/islamic-state-kills-six-hostages-including-paramilitary-fighters-in-mosul/ (Iraqi News)]
;Arts and culture
*[[Zara Phillips]], granddaughter of [[Elizabeth II|Queen Elizabeth II]], gives birth to a second daughter (later named [[Lena Tindall|Lena Elizabeth Tindall]]). [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-44537478 (BBC)]
;Business and economy
*[[Google]] announces that it will invest [[US$]]550 million in the [[China|Chinese]] [[e-commerce]] company [[JD.com]]. [http://money.cnn.com/2018/06/18/technology/google-invest-jd-china/index.html (CNN)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Osaka earthquake]]
**A [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude]] 5.5 earthquake strikes [[Osaka]], [[Japan]], at 7:58 a.m. [[Japan Standard Time|local time]] (22:58 [[UTC]], June 17). At least five people have been killed and several are transported to hospitals with injuries. Electrical services are disrupted citywide, affecting 170,000 buildings. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20180618_16/ (NHK)]
*[[List of shipwrecks in 2018|Shipwrecks in 2018]]
**A ship catches fire in [[Port Kembla (seaport)|Port Kembla]] in [[New South Wales]], [[Australia]], forcing the port's temporary closure. [http://www.miningweekly.com/article/australias-port-kembla-reopens-after-cargo-ship-blaze-2018-06-18 (''Mining Weekly'')]
**A second attempt is made to extinguish burning [[container ship]]  MV ''SSL Kolkata'' in the [[Bay of Bengal]] off [[India]] after rough conditions prompted an abandonment of yesterday's efforts. [https://www.telegraphindia.com/calcutta/sea-foils-ship-mission-238488 (''Telegraph India'')]
;Law and crime
*[[Corruption in Spain]]
**[[Iñaki Urdangarin]], brother-in-law of King [[Felipe VI]] of Spain, enters prison to serve the sentence of almost 6 years for the [[Nóos case]]. [http://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20180618/45209392431/inaki-urdangarin-prision-mujeres-brieva-avila.html (''La Vanguardia'')]
*[[Volkswagen emissions scandal]]
**[[Audi]] CEO [[Rupert Stadler]] is arrested in [[Ingolstadt]], [[Germany]], over "clear signs that there was to be an effort to influence people and other suspects". Stadler is being investigated for suspected fraud and false advertising. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-volkswagen-emissions-stadler/head-of-vws-audi-arrested-in-germany-over-diesel-scandal-idUSKBN1JE0R3 (Reuters)]
*[[Cannabis in Canada]]
**The [[House of Commons of Canada|House of Commons]] of [[Canada]] votes to [[Cannabis Act (Canada)|legalize]] recreational [[cannabis]]. The bill will now head back to the [[Senate of Canada|Senate]], where it is expected to be passed into law. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/canada-cannabis-legal-vote-commons-recreational-use-a8405336.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Crime in Sweden#Gun violence|Gun violence in Sweden]]
**Three men are killed and another three men are injured in a [[drive-by shooting]] outside an [[Internet cafe]] near a [[police station]] in central [[Malmö]], Sweden. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44531447 (BBC)]
*[[Shooting of XXXTentacion]]
**American rapper [[XXXTentacion]] is shot dead in [[Deerfield Beach, Florida|Deerfield Beach]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. [https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/rapper-xxxtentacion-shot-miami-condition-unknown-report-1121016 (''The Hollywood Reporter'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-44529367 (BBC)]
*[[Israel]] charges former energy minister [[Gonen Segev]] with spying for [[Iran]]. Segev is in custody; he was extradited from [[Equatorial Guinea]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-44520850 (BBC)]
*The [[United States Supreme Court]] sidesteps two major partisan gerrymandering cases, allowing challenged voter redistricting maps to be used in this year's midterms. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/18/politics/supreme-court-gerrymandering-decision/index.html (CNN)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Militarisation of space]]
**[[President of the United States|US President]] [[Donald Trump]] directs the [[United States Department of Defense|Department of Defense]] to begin the process of establishing a "[[United States Space Force|space force]]" as the sixth military branch of the [[United States Armed Forces]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/06/18/president-trump-directs-pentagon-defense-department-to-immediately-being-the-process-of-establishing-space-force-as-sixth-military-branch.html (CNBC)]
*The [[Joko Widodo]] {{ill|Presidency of Joko Widodo|id|Kepresidenan Joko Widodo|lt=administration}} of [[Indonesia]] appoints {{ill|Mochamad Iriawan|id}}, an active [[Polri|police]] general, as acting governor of [[West Java]] bringing back [[dwifungsi|dual function]]. [http://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2018/06/18/ex-west-java-police-chief-inaugurated-provinces-acting-governor.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]
;Sports
*The foreign minister of the [[Central African Republic]], [[Charles-Armel Doubane]], says that tennis player [[Boris Becker]] is not an official diplomat of the country. [http://www.kansascity.com/entertainment/article213368394.html (AP via ''The Kansas City Star'')]
